title: Leeds, England — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Leeds is a city in England with a population of 812,665. A major financial center in the north with a booming legal sector, vibrant nightlife, and affordable housing compared to London. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 140 sunny days a year.
